title: Finite-source exact cohomology segment for a projective embedding
statement: Let $T$ be affine with $A=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ Noetherian [def-pc-scheme], $N$ a finite coordinate type and $j:Y\hookrightarrow P=\mathbb P(N;T)$ a closed immersion [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change, def-weil-closed-immersion]. For a quasi-coherent finitely presented module $F$ on $Y$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $q\in\mathbb N$, there exist a quasi-coherent finitely presented module $K$ on $P$, a finite $A$-module $V$, and $A$-linear maps $V\to H^q(Y,F)\to H^{q+1}(P,K)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] exact at the middle term. The action on $H^q(Y,F)$ is restricted along $(j\circ\pi)^\sharp$ and that on $H^{q+1}(P,K)$ along $\pi^\sharp$. No finiteness assumption or conclusion is imposed on the last term.

proof.text: Identify affine T with Spec Gamma(T,O). Transport the embedding to the projective space over this ring, and push F forward. Closed pushforward is quasi-coherent and finitely presented and has the same cohomology. The comparison commutes with multiplication by sections of T. For an empty coordinate type both schemes are empty, and zero modules provide the required segment.

Choose an epimorphism E -> j_*F from a finite sum of negative twists using finite generators on the standard charts and clearing denominators. Its kernel K is quasi-coherent and finitely presented; transport K back to P(N;T).

The long exact cohomology sequence gives H^q(E) -> H^q(j_*F) -> H^(q+1)(K). Cohomology commutes with finite sums, and the monomial standard-cover calculation over the base ring makes H^q(E) finite. Take this as V. Transport the middle term through closed pushforward. Multiplication by base sections acts on the short exact sequence and its connecting maps, so both displayed maps are Gamma(T,O)-linear for the stated actions; forgetting those actions preserves exactness.

proof_origin.note: P2 extracted the finite-source exact-segment step, without its descending-induction conclusion; checked against the Stacks pages for 01YS and 01Y6.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_projective_finite_source_cohomology_segment
    {Y T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(T, ⊤)]
    (N : Type u) [Finite N] (j : Y ⟶ ℙ(N; T)) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] (q : ℕ) :
    letI : Module Γ(T, ⊤) (F.H q) :=
      Module.compHom _ (j ≫ (ℙ(N; T) ↘ T)).appTop.hom
    ∃ (K : (ℙ(N; T)).Modules) (_ : K.IsQuasicoherent) (_ : K.IsFinitePresentation),
      letI : Module Γ(T, ⊤) (K.H (q + 1)) :=
        Module.compHom _ (ℙ(N; T) ↘ T).appTop.hom
      ∃ (V : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(T, ⊤)) (_ : Module.Finite Γ(T, ⊤) V)
        (a : V →ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)] F.H q) (b : F.H q →ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)] K.H (q + 1)),
        Function.Exact a b
